release.decision: The implementation satisfies the bounded 1.0.0-rc.1 release-candidate gates for its recorded scope: complete browser play, deterministic large simulation, current-source contract suites, executed technical publications, dependency review, and a fresh neutral clean-room directory proof. This is not a general-availability, universal conformance, or untested-environment claim.

included_scope: One deterministic single-player browser night with six concurrent rooms and twenty-four accepted decisions.
Autonomous logical-time room evolution, exactly-once cross-room receipts, close snapshots, afterimages, replay, and complete-night interpretation.
Player-controlled session, local-slot, portable export, bounded import, migration, validation, and recovery behavior.
One-viewport interaction, progressive disclosure, relationship exploration with text parity, motion controls, and responsive layout contracts.
Canonical source, tests, documentation, executed notebooks, raw static HTML, machine results, and a neutral source distribution.
excluded_scope: Accounts, remote state synchronization, collaborative multiplayer, live scenario feeds, analytics, and player profiling.
Prediction, diagnosis, deception detection, trust scoring, empirical effect estimation, or reconstruction of a real person or dispute.
Every possible 32-bit seed, every combinatorial action path, and browser or assistive-technology combinations absent from the verified matrix.
Violence, emergency response, clinical care, legal process, abuse assessment, or operational manipulation instruction.

gates.label: Large simulation and edge cases
gates.claim: A finite contiguous 4,096-seed sweep generated coherent nights; 512 interleaved nights completed and replayed with exactly-once decision and autonomous receipts and zero recorded invariant failures.
gates.limit: Finite domain and four deterministic choice policies; not exhaustive over all seeds or all action paths.

gates.label: End-to-end playable night
gates.claim: A fresh 52-step Chrome-family run bound to the hardened source reached turn 24/24, closed six of six rooms, opened the whole-night conclusion with 24 decisions, retained exact 1363 by 936 viewport containment, and recorded zero application-origin warnings or errors.
gates.limit: One Chrome-family engine, desktop viewport, and locator-driven completion; no physical mobile, assistive-technology pair, or second engine. Earlier keyboard, focus, local-slot, and export-control observations retain prior-source provenance.

gates.label: Persistence, import/export, privacy, and failure states
gates.claim: The hardened-source clean-room run passed 10 save-model tests covering session-only default, consent, round trip, migration, hostile input, integrity, replay, and atomic rejection. Browser local-slot and export-control observations are retained separately under their earlier-source provenance.
gates.limit: Browser fixture upload, runtime import, download file arrival, and request-level network observation were unavailable; no pass is claimed for those runtime observations.

gates.label: Accessibility and responsive interaction
gates.claim: The hardened-source repository and clean-room runs passed 21 accessibility-disclosure and 8 viewport contracts; the fresh browser completion retained exact viewport containment and zero application-origin errors.
gates.limit: No accessibility-rule scanner, screen-reader or other assistive-technology pairing, physical mobile/touch device, second browser engine, or multi-engine zoom matrix was run; no universal conformance claim is made.

gates.label: Dependency and supply-chain state
gates.claim: Direct dependency pins, registry integrity, and exact lifecycle-script approvals are recorded; complete and runtime-only advisory queries returned zero known advisories for the bound lockfile.
gates.limit: Registry advisories are time-bound and cannot prove that dependencies contain no undisclosed defect.

gates.label: Executed notebooks and raw HTML
gates.claim: Repository and neutral clean-room documentation checks verified executed notebook source, static script-free HTML, publication metadata, local links, contrast floors, and artifact digests; the browser loaded the evidence index and both notebook HTML routes.
gates.limit: Notebook cells render retained evidence and fixed declarations; they do not execute the browser or TypeScript release harnesses.

gates.label: Neutral clean distribution
gates.claim: A fresh 78-file neutral directory passed the strict identity/content scan, installed 504 packages with an empty task cache, repeated release verification with zero focused-test failures, built independently, started production, and returned HTTP 200 root HTML.
gates.limit: The retained machine result is the first pre-binding directory proof. Final post-binding archive container bytes and SHA-256 are verified externally to avoid recursive self-digests.

limitations: The large simulation is a deterministic finite sample, not exhaustive proof over every seed or every action path.

A real-browser complete-night path is current-source evidence, but manual keyboard, focus, local-slot, and export-control observations in the same artifact retain their earlier-source provenance and are not relabeled as current execution.

The retained neutral directory proof predates inclusion of its own result file; a final post-binding archive retest and external archive SHA-256 are required because embedding the archive digest inside that archive would be recursive.
Automated semantic and viewport contracts cannot establish full accessibility conformance across absent browser and assistive-technology combinations.
Runtime browser import, download arrival, and request-level network observation remain unverified even though deterministic save, hostile-input, and export-control contracts passed.
Executed notebooks render retained evidence and fixed declarations; they do not themselves run the browser or TypeScript simulation harness.
Dependency advisory results are time-bound and do not establish absence of unknown defects.
